messages.content: You are a concise Warnetech assistant.
It is the single exit point for model calls: it retries failures, falls back to another model, rate limits and tracks cost.
How do I run without internet?
Set WARNETECH_LOCAL_ONLY=1 and use a local model alias. No hosted provider is registered, so nothing leaves the machine.
Which model summarises best on a small machine?
The summarise role uses gemma2:2b, the smallest of the three local models.
Can the interpreter run code without asking?
Not from the CLI or MCP. Every action needs approval, and the default approver denies.
